metadata.description: V2 create device sensor assignment (POST /devicesensors/{sensorUuid}/assignment), 201. NOTE: 'smart_group_uuids' is NOT listed as required in swagger's DeviceSensorAssignmentRequestV1Model but IS required on the real wire (422 'Smart group assignment identifiers cannot be empty' when omitted) -- reused an existing built-in smart group ('All Devices') rather than creating one. The response's uuid appears identical to create_sensor_v2.json's anonymized uuid only because both fixture bodies are the single-key shape {"uuid": ...} and mock-capture's anonymizer deterministically reseeds its PRNG (gofakeit.Seed(12345)) on every call -- the first fake UUID drawn after a reseed is the same each time. This is a coincidence of the anonymization scheme, not evidence of a real API defect (independently confirmed via a raw, non-fixture create+list check: real create-response uuids do match the real persisted resource).
